leadText:
(Japanese: ジョジョ島 Jojo Island) is an -exclusive location between the Hoenn cities of Mossdeep City and Sootopolis City. It is the setting of the worldwide banned episode AG101 (unaired).

A group of were causing massive earthquakes across Jojo Island. and joined forces with a local boy named Chōta to combat the Whiscash.
